title: More capable embeddings, with one migration to mind
summary:
Embeddings gained image inputs and more room for text, community publishers got a request path, and the model and app catalogs got easier to navigate.

`cohere-embed-v4` accepts text with one image per input and supports `query` and `document` retrieval roles. `qwen3-embedding-8b` lists a 40,960-token context limit. `gemini-2` moved to Gemini Embedding 2's GA endpoint, which produces vectors in a different space: stored preview-era vectors need re-embedding before comparison. Model-specific dimensions, Gemini task instructions, and the associated usage rules are documented.

My Models and the API docs link to a new request form for community model publishers. It covers access to publish models publicly, not registration of individual models; signed-in users can still register and call private, owner-only models without that access.

Registry descriptions across text, image, audio, embeddings, 3D, and realtime models now explain uses and trade-offs. The high-context Perplexity Sonar preset is named `perplexity-high`; its previous names remain aliases, and the catalog distinguishes it from fast search.

daily.title: Images meet Cohere embeddings
daily.text: `cohere-embed-v4` accepts text with one image per input, plus `input_type: query` or `document` for retrieval. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=cohere-embed-v4).

daily.title: Gemini embeddings move to GA
daily.text: `gemini-2` uses Gemini Embedding 2's GA endpoint. Its vectors occupy a different space, so re-embed stored preview-era data before comparing it with new results. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-2).

daily.title: Longer Qwen embedding inputs
daily.text: `qwen3-embedding-8b` supports inputs up to the deployment's 40,960-token context limit, up from 32,768. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen3-embedding-8b).

daily.title: Request public model publishing
daily.text: A new form linked from My Models and the API docs lets you request access to publish community models in the public catalog. Private, owner-only models do not require that access. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
